title: Attracthor2 Continuous Structure Search
description: Searches generated number streams for hidden patterns and unusual behavior.

progress.label: Experiments tested
progress.help: Attracthor2 has no target iteration count. The counter grows until the Project Tool is paused.

best.label: Strongest unexplained lead
best.help: Highest unexplained anomaly score found so far. Higher means more unusual and worth checking again.

metrics.label: Unexplained threshold crossings
metrics.help: Results that looked unusual enough to deserve another check.

metrics.label: Positive controls caught
metrics.help: Known LCG32 weaknesses caught by the detector. They are test cases, not discoveries.

metrics.label: Terminal leads archived
metrics.help: Saved shortlist of up to 128 unusual leads that reached the deepest check.

details.contract: same ELF + same compact experiment input = same byte-identical result
details.strategy: continuous exploration with deterministic verify, neighbor, alternate-seed and control follow-ups; known LCG32 low-bit defects are positive controls rather than discoveries
details.phase_space: 3D 16x16x16 bins from delay, delta-delay or bijective permuted-delay embeddings
details.hardware_rng: not used as a source because Microgrid consensus requires deterministic outputs
